recap: Cavaliers beat the Wizards 117–107 in overtime.
Donovan Mitchell led the Cavaliers with 37 points (12-29 FG, 5-12 3PT), 5 rebounds and 4 assists.
Bradley Beal led the Wizards with 27 points (11-16 FG, 0-1 3PT), 4 rebounds and 5 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: ball security, second chances, getting to the line. Effective FG% 49.5 to 56.3.
Biggest swing: Kyle Kuzma shooting foul (OT 1:43), +21 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): Neto, LeVert, Lopez, Love, Wade, +4 in 4:33.
Bench points: CLE 43, WSH 36. Points in the paint: 48–54. Second-chance points: 24–14.
